title: Supporting Staff with Grief: A Guide for Leaders
organization: SE Health / Saint Elizabeth Health Care Research Centre
usable_for: peer support, debriefing, leader check-in, and staff grief vocabulary
do_not_use_for: clinical or therapeutic care for workers
public release of identifiable worker stories, patient stories, case details, child material, suicide/overdose method details, or restricted cultural material
substituting source summaries for consented worker testimony and role-specific review
extraction_rules: Extract role vocabulary, burden vocabulary, organizational-support boundaries, and review obligations only.
Do not extract identifiable patient, family, worker, employer, call, scene, image, or case details.
Treat worker grief as evidence of the deathwork ecology, not as entertainment, accusation, or therapy content.
Cite source_id in every dependent record and recompute dependencies after record changes.
review_notes: Card added in rev0022 for worker-carried-death / deathwork burden architecture; not a public-release authority.
